_note: Simulated vendor advisories. IDs and details are invented for the game (UE- prefix) except named historical events, which are summarised in general terms.

advisories.title: IP Input process crash on malformed fragments
advisories.desc: Routers running affected releases may reload when they receive a crafted fragmented IP packet.

advisories.title: Memory leak in SNMP process
advisories.desc: Polling certain MIBs leaks processor memory. After weeks of uptime the device runs out of memory and reloads.

advisories.title: SSH server denial of service
advisories.desc: A remote attacker can crash the SSH server process, preventing management access.

advisories.title: IOSd crash when processing OSPF LSAs
advisories.desc: Affected releases reload unexpectedly after receiving a specific sequence of OSPF updates.

advisories.title: Web UI privilege escalation
advisories.desc: An unauthenticated attacker can create an administrator account through the HTTP server. Disable the HTTP server or upgrade.

advisories.title: Memory leak in LACP manager
advisories.desc: Each port-channel flap leaks memory. Eventually the switch reloads.

advisories.title: Kernel panic on malformed LLDP frame
advisories.desc: A crafted LLDP frame from an adjacent device can reload the switch.

advisories.title: Reload when inspecting malformed SIP
advisories.desc: Traffic through the firewall can trigger a reload of the security appliance.

advisories.title: IKEv1/IKEv2 buffer overflow
advisories.desc: A remote, unauthenticated attacker can execute code or reload the appliance.

advisories.title: DVMRP memory exhaustion
advisories.desc: Crafted IGMP traffic exhausts process memory, causing protocol restarts and route-processor reloads.

advisories.title: rpd memory leak with BGP route refresh
advisories.desc: Repeated BGP route-refresh messages leak memory in the routing process.

advisories.title: rpd core on malformed BGP UPDATE
advisories.desc: A malformed BGP attribute received from a peer crashes the routing process; all routing protocols restart.

advisories.title: J-Web remote code execution
advisories.desc: Unauthenticated access to J-Web can lead to code execution. Disable J-Web or upgrade.

advisories.title: evo-pfemand crash on interface flap storm
advisories.desc: Rapid interface flaps can crash the packet forwarding manager.

advisories.title: Switch reboot on crafted HTTP request
advisories.desc: The web management interface can be made to reboot the switch.

advisories.title: hpe-config memory leak
advisories.desc: Configuration checkpoints leak memory; the switch eventually reboots.

advisories.title: Controller crash on PAPI message
advisories.desc: A crafted PAPI message from the network reloads the controller; APs fail over or go down.

advisories.title: SSL-VPN path traversal
advisories.desc: An unauthenticated attacker can read system files over the SSL-VPN web portal.

advisories.title: SSL-VPN heap overflow
advisories.desc: Remote code execution through crafted requests to the SSL-VPN.

advisories.title: Switch reboot on LACP PDU storm
advisories.desc: A burst of LACP PDUs can reboot the switch.

advisories.title: Heartbleed (OpenSSL TLS heartbeat over-read)
advisories.desc: Historical event: an OpenSSL bug let attackers read server memory over TLS. Patch management interfaces and rotate keys.
